outputs.question: How do I create a group conversation?

answer.message: Open Messaging from the app header, choose New group, enter a group name, select at least one other participant, and choose Create group.

sources.title: Create a group conversation
sources.guidance: Open Messaging from the app header. Choose New group, enter a group name, select at least one other participant, then choose Create group. Only the creator can rename the group or add/remove participants. Current members share the full history; removed members lose access. Previously signed attachment links may remain usable for up to ten minutes.
sources.source: Messaging groups and replies · released October 22

outputs.question: How do I enable iPhone notifications?

answer.message: Here is guidance from the TenOps Guide.

sources.title: Enable phone notifications
sources.guidance: On iPhone, open TenOps in Safari, choose Share → Add to Home Screen, then open the Home Screen app. In Settings, find device notifications and choose Enable notifications on this device. Allow the system permission prompt. If permission was denied, allow notifications in iPhone Settings and retry. Device registration does not guarantee that every notification will be presented.
sources.source: Device notification guide · reliability release October 22
constraints: If permission was denied, allow notifications in iPhone Settings and retry.
Device registration does not guarantee that every notification will be presented.

outputs.question: How do I find an existing customer's Jobs?

answer.message: Here is guidance from the TenOps Guide.

sources.title: Find a customer’s previous Jobs
sources.guidance: Open Contacts and search for the beginning of the customer’s company name. Choose Linked Jobs beside that customer, then select a Job to open it. This shows only visible Production Jobs linked to that directory customer. Historical customer text and Bid names do not establish a link; Proposal customer details are independent snapshots.
sources.path: Contacts → Search customers → Linked Jobs → select a Job
sources.source: Contacts guide · deployed release verified October 22
constraints: This shows only visible Production Jobs linked to that directory customer.
Historical customer text and Bid names do not establish a link; Proposal customer details are independent snapshots.

sources.title: Add someone to a personal DM
sources.guidance: Partially: you can start a new group, but you cannot add a third person to a personal DM. Create a new group instead. The old DM stays private and its history is not copied into the group.
